title: ALL THINGS PRAISE THEE
author: George W. Conder (1821-1874)
stanzas: All things praise Thee, Lord most high, heaven and earth, and sea and sky; all were for Thy glory made, that Thy greatness thus displayed should all worship bring to Thee: so we praise Thee, Lord, may we!.

All things praise Thee - night to night sings in silent hymns of light: all things praise Thee - day to day Chants Thy power in burning ray; time and space are praising Thee: All things praise Thee, Lord, may we!.
All thing praise Thee - high and low, Rain and dew and sparkling snow, Crimson sunset, fleecy cloud,Rippling stream, and Tempest loud; summer, winter, all to Thee Glory render - Lord, may we!
All things praise Thee - heav'n's high shrine rings with melody divine; lowly bending at Thy feet, seraph and archangel meet, This their highest bliss to be, ever praising: so may we.
All things praise Thee, gracious Lord, great Creator, powerful Word, omnipresent Spirit, now at Thy feet we humbly bow, lift our hearts in praise to Thee: so we praise Thee, Lord, may we!.
